parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the synchronization or migration task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. This is a global parameter that does not need to be specified for this operation.

parameters.name: ShardPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the shard in a MongoDB sharded cluster instance.

> - This parameter is available and required only when the source database instance is a MongoDB sharded cluster instance.
- This parameter takes effect only when **ModifyAccount** is set to **true**.

parameters.name: ShardUsername
parameters.description: The account of the shard in a MongoDB sharded cluster instance.
